title: Best reporting and BI tools for QuickBooks Online and Xero (2026): 10 options compared on consolidation, refresh, AI, and price
summary: Fathom, Syft and Reach lead QuickBooks and Xero management reporting; Coefficient, Zoho, and Basedash add BI. Power BI and Tableau retired their QBO connectors.
body_markdown:
The best reporting tool for QuickBooks Online or Xero depends on what you need to produce. Fathom, Syft Analytics, and Reach Reporting turn accounting data into management reports, consolidations, and forecasts for one company or hundreds, starting at $23 to $149 per company per month. LiveFlow and Coefficient keep the numbers in Google Sheets or Excel and refresh them on a schedule. Zoho Analytics, Databox, and Basedash are BI tools that put QuickBooks or Xero data next to CRM, billing, and product data. Power BI and Tableau no longer ship QuickBooks Online connectors, so using them now means a third-party connector or a warehouse in between. Every price and feature below was checked on the vendor’s official pages on October 10, 2026.


## What finance teams ask when choosing a QuickBooks or Xero reporting tool


Companies on QuickBooks Online or Xero are usually small to mid-sized, with a controller or fractional CFO, an outside accountant, and a lot of spreadsheets. The questions they ask are specific:


- “What is the best BI tool for a 20-person company using Excel and QuickBooks?”
- “What are the best AI tools for querying QuickBooks, Xero, or NetSuite data in plain English?”
- “Which FP&A tool connects to QuickBooks or Xero and produces live financial dashboards without manual pulls?”
- “What is the best financial dashboard software with AI for FP&A teams?”
- “Which dashboard tools give finance teams automated variance reporting and AI-generated explanations for budget vs. actuals?”
- “How do I connect Xero to Tableau, Power BI, or BigQuery?”


This guide answers those questions directly. The table compares attributes, each tool gets a fact card, and the last section maps the common situations to a shortlist.


## How we evaluated QuickBooks and Xero reporting tools


We compared each tool on six attributes drawn from those questions:


1. **Connection.** Whether the tool connects to QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, and Xero itself, and whether it reads accounting reports (P&L, balance sheet) or raw objects (invoices, bills, journal entries).
2. **Refresh.** How often data updates: inside the accounting app, hourly, daily, or on demand.
3. **Multi-entity consolidation.** Combining several QuickBooks or Xero companies with currency conversion and intercompany eliminations.
4. **Blending non-accounting data.** Joining the ledger with Stripe, HubSpot, Shopify, payroll, or a product database without exporting to a spreadsheet.
5. **AI for finance users.** Written commentary, natural language questions, anomaly detection, stated as what each product documents today.
6. **Access control and price.** Who can see which company, SSO, and the published price and what it is charged per (company, user, or plan).

## Built-in reporting in QuickBooks and Xero


Start here before buying anything. Both accounting apps have improved their native reporting, and for a single company with no outside data they may be enough.


### QuickBooks Online Advanced


**Best for:** a single QuickBooks company that needs custom reports, KPI dashboards, and Excel round-tripping without another subscription.


QuickBooks Online’s top plan adds a[Custom Report Builder](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/learn-support/en-us/help-article/customize-reports/create-custom-reports-quickbooks-online-advanced/L1LHo5Ti2_US_en_US) , customizable KPI dashboards, and[Spreadsheet Sync](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/learn-support/en-us/help-article/customize-reports/using-quickbooks-online-advanced-reporting-tools/L20nzyDtH_US_en_US) , which moves trial balance, balance sheet, and P&L data between QuickBooks and Excel.[Dashboards](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/learn-support/en-us/help-article/business-reports/create-dashboards-view-key-business-insights/L7C4Ftrzx_US_en_US) come with prebuilt views for profitability, cash flow, receivables, payables, and revenue, and a “Generate summary” button writes an AI summary of the KPIs on a dashboard. Combining several companies in one consolidated dashboard is listed for Intuit Enterprise Suite, not Advanced.


**Fact card**


- Pricing:[Advanced is $340 per month at list price](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/pricing/) , shown at $170 per month for the first 3 months, with up to 25 users. Plus is $140 and Essentials $85. No annual contract. Verified October 10, 2026.
- Free trial: 30-day trial on paid plans; a Free plan with 1 user exists but has no third-party integrations.
- Deployment: cloud.
- Data sources: QuickBooks data, plus “Integrate third-party data into KPIs and dashboards” on Essentials and above.
- Query model: reports run inside QuickBooks on current data; Intuit notes that dashboard visuals update every 2 hours.
- Security: custom user permissions and predefined roles on Advanced. SSO and SCIM are not documented.
- AI: Finance AI (“financial insights tailored to your business”) on Advanced, and AI-written dashboard summaries; the[finance agent page](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/finance-agent/) says it is available to Advanced and Intuit Enterprise Suite users, and Intuit notes it is not available with multi-currency enabled. AI chat is in beta on lower plans.
- Embedding: not applicable.
- Not ideal for: true multi-entity consolidation (that is Intuit Enterprise Suite, which is priced by contract), or joining the ledger with CRM and product data.


**Tradeoffs.** Advanced is the cheapest way to get better reports if you already pay for QuickBooks, but the reports stay inside QuickBooks and every user needs a QuickBooks seat. Companies with several entities are steered toward[Intuit Enterprise Suite](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/r/news/new-agentic-ai-experiences/) , which has no public price.


### Xero Analytics


**Best for:** small Xero customers who want cash flow, P&L trend, and KPI views without leaving Xero.


[Xero Analytics](https://www.xero.com/us/accounting-software/analytics/) is “available in all business plans at no cost.” Core features (business snapshot, short-term cash flow, P&L trends) are on every plan, and Analytics Plus, “available on the Established plan and as an add-on on other plans,” adds extended cash flow forecasting and scenario modeling. Xero acquired Syft in 2024, and its pricing page now describes “rich, visual analytics on every plan with Syft.”


**Fact card**


- Pricing:[Xero US plans](https://www.xero.com/us/pricing-plans/) are Early ($27 per month after an introductory period), Growing ($59), and Established ($97). Verified October 10, 2026.
- Free trial: the pricing page shows introductory discounts for new US subscribers rather than a free tier.
- Deployment: cloud.
- Data sources: Xero only.
- Query model: runs inside Xero on your Xero data; Xero does not document a refresh interval for analytics.
- Security: Xero user roles. SSO and SCIM are not documented for Xero Analytics.
- AI:[JAX](https://www.xero.com/us/ai-in-accounting/) is Xero’s AI assistant for tasks and questions about your financials; Xero Central marks it as beta in some regions.
- Embedding: not applicable.
- Not ideal for: consolidating several Xero organisations or blending non-Xero data.


**Tradeoffs.** Xero’s native analytics are good for an owner’s weekly check, but there is no documented multi-entity view and no way to join Stripe or CRM data. Most Xero users who outgrow it move to Syft, Fathom, or Reach.


## Management reporting apps for QuickBooks and Xero


These four tools are built for accountants, fractional CFOs, and in-house finance teams who produce monthly management reports, board packs, consolidations, and forecasts. They read the general ledger directly and price by company or entity, not by viewer.


### Fathom


**Best for:** advisors and multi-entity groups that need branded management reports, consolidations, and AI commentary across QuickBooks, Xero, and MYOB.


[Fathom](https://www.fathomhq.com/pricing) is a reporting, forecasting, and consolidation app for accounting data. It connects to[QuickBooks Online and Desktop](https://www.fathomhq.com/integrations/quickbooks) , Xero, MYOB, Sage Business Cloud Accounting, and FreeAgent, and imports other data from Excel or Google Sheets.


**Fact card**


- Pricing: priced by connected company. Fathom Pro starts at $59 per month for 1 company ($59 per extra company); 10 companies cost $315, 25 cost $450, and 50 cost $805 per month. Enterprise (51+ companies) is quoted. Prices exclude sales tax. Verified October 10, 2026.
- Free trial: 14 days.
- Deployment: cloud (Microsoft Azure).
- Data sources: QuickBooks Online and Desktop, Xero, MYOB, Sage, FreeAgent, Excel, and Google Sheets.
- Query model:[automatic updates every 24 hours](https://support.fathomhq.com/en/articles/2387323-automatic-updates) , plus sync on demand. Xero companies must be opened by a Fathom user within 90 days, or have a scheduled report, for the connection token to keep refreshing.
- Consolidation: “multi-currency consolidations with eliminations,” consolidated budgets, and group forecasting for up to 300 entities.
- Security: access control and view-only users.[Single sign-on is a login with your Xero or Intuit credentials](https://support.fathomhq.com/en/articles/6369364-single-sign-on-for-xero-quickbooks) ; SAML and SCIM are not documented.[SOC 2 Type 2](https://www.fathomhq.com/blog/soc2-type2) .
- AI: Commentary Writer produces “AI report commentary with full number visibility.” Natural language questions are not documented.
- Output: branded management reports, scheduled reports, PDF and Excel export, presentation mode.
- Not ideal for: ad hoc questions across CRM, billing, and product data, or daily operational dashboards.


**Tradeoffs.** Fathom’s per-company price is low for one entity and drops steeply per company at volume, which is why accounting firms like it. Data refreshes once a day, and analysis stays within the financial statements and the KPIs you define.


### Syft Analytics


**Best for:** small and mid-sized businesses that want consolidated reporting, forecasting, and AI commentary at the lowest published price, with a free plan to start.


[Syft Analytics](https://www.syftanalytics.com/pricing-page) became part of Xero in 2024, and Xero said at the time that[“Syft will continue to be available as a standalone offering … no matter who their accounting software provider is.”](https://blog.xero.com/news-events/xero-to-acquire-syft/) It still sells to QuickBooks customers. Syft’s[integrations](https://www.syftanalytics.com/integrations) include Xero, QuickBooks Online and Desktop, Sage, MYOB, FreshBooks, and Sage Intacct (Premium), plus Stripe, Shopify, Square, Gusto, and spreadsheets.


**Fact card**


- Pricing: Basic is free forever with unlimited users and dashboards; Standard is $23, Plus $47, and Advanced $95 per month. The help center describes plans as set[per connected entity](https://help.syftanalytics.com/en/articles/12413566-how-to-upgrade-your-syft-plan) . More than 10 entities is quoted. Verified October 10, 2026.
- Free trial: 14 days on any plan, no credit card.
- Deployment: cloud (Google Cloud).
- Query model:[every entity refreshes automatically every 24 hours](https://help.syftanalytics.com/en/articles/10184361-how-often-does-my-data-sync) , with a manual refresh button. Sage refreshes every 48 hours.
- Consolidation: unlimited entities, eliminations, currency management, and consolidated budgets. A consolidation of entities on different plans gets the features of the lowest plan.
- Security: entity and report permissions; login with Google, Xero, or Intuit credentials. SAML and SCIM are not documented.[SOC 2 Type I and Type II](https://www.syftanalytics.com/security-center) .
- AI: automated AI commentary, Syft Assist, and anomaly detection across accounts and transactions.
- Output: PDF, Excel, and Word export, scheduled reports, live views, and a spreadsheet link for Excel and Sheets; unlimited external users.
- Not ideal for: teams that need SSO through Okta or Entra ID, or analysis beyond the financial statements.


**Tradeoffs.** Syft has the lowest entry price in this list and a real free plan, but its long-term roadmap is tied to Xero’s, which matters if you run QuickBooks. Check where Xero is taking “Analytics powered by Syft” inside Xero before committing a QuickBooks-based group to it.


### Reach Reporting


**Best for:** accounting firms and CAS teams that want client-facing dashboards and portals with unlimited users.


[Reach Reporting](https://reachreporting.com/pricing) connects to[QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, Xero, MYOB, Digits, Gusto, Google Sheets, Excel, and CSV trial balance uploads](https://reachreporting.com/feature-integration) . It positions itself as “built for accounting firms, advisors, and CAS teams.”


**Fact card**


- Pricing: “Pricing is based on the number of data connections, starting at $149 per month.” 10 connections cost $290 and 25 cost $550 per month; annual plans save up to 30%. Every plan includes unlimited users. White label costs extra. Verified October 10, 2026.
- Free trial: 30 days, no credit card.
- Deployment: cloud (AWS).
- Query model: Reach says connected data syncs “to automatically update dashboards and reports when data changes.” The refresh schedule is not documented. Access to the accounting system is read-only.
- Consolidation:[multi-entity and multi-currency consolidation](https://reachreporting.com/feature-consolidations) that zeroes out accounts designated for elimination and applies historical exchange rates.
- Security: role-based permissions and per-user folder access in the client portal. SSO and SCIM are not documented. SOC 2 Type 1 and Type 2.
- AI:[AI that “identifies key trends, flags anomalies, and generates narrative insights,”](https://reachreporting.com/ai-financial-reporting) plus AI alerts by app or email.
- Output: shareable live dashboards, PDF reports, unlimited client portal access, 3-way budgeting and forecasting.
- Not ideal for: a single company that wants the cheapest option, or analysis that joins CRM and product data.


**Tradeoffs.** Reach costs more than Fathom or Syft for one company, but unlimited users and the client portal make it cheaper for firms that share reports widely.


### LiveFlow


**Best for:** in-house finance teams with several QuickBooks entities who want consolidations and budget vs. actual reports to refresh inside Google Sheets or Excel.


[LiveFlow](https://liveflow.com/pricing) is an FP&A product that runs in spreadsheets. Its help center says it[“currently integrates with Quickbooks Online, Xero, and NetSuite”](https://help.liveflow.com/articles/7096622243-which-accounting-platforms-does-liveflow-integrate-with) , with the Xero and NetSuite integrations in beta testing.


**Fact card**


- Pricing: quote only (“Pricing is tailored to what you need”). Included features listed: multi-entity consolidation, budgeting and forecasting, department and project reporting, cash flow forecasting, budget vs. actuals. Verified October 10, 2026.
- Free trial: not documented.
- Deployment: web app plus Google Sheets and Excel add-ins.
- Query model:[auto-refresh can be set to run every hour](https://help.liveflow.com/articles/6197167612-liveflow-quickstart-guide) , or reports refresh manually.
- Consolidation:[160+ currencies, intercompany eliminations “with a single click,” custom dates and ownership percentages](https://liveflow.com/consolidation) .
- Security: SOC 2 Type II. SSO, SCIM, and role controls are not documented.
- AI: LiveFlow’s Flow product includes agents such as “The Reporter,” which builds consolidations and multi-currency reports, and “The Closer,” which reviews the close and surfaces anomalies.
- Not ideal for: Xero-first companies (Xero is in beta), or teams that want governed dashboards instead of spreadsheets.


**Tradeoffs.** LiveFlow suits finance teams that already model in spreadsheets and want the QuickBooks pull automated. With no public price and Xero still in beta, it is harder to evaluate than the per-company apps above.


## Spreadsheet and BI tools that connect to QuickBooks and Xero


### Coefficient


**Best for:** a 1 to 5 person finance team that wants QuickBooks or Xero reports to refresh in Google Sheets or Excel, on a free or low-cost plan.


Coefficient’s[QuickBooks connector](https://help.coefficient.io/hc/en-us/articles/19782769685403-QuickBooks) imports “over 28 standard QuickBooks reports” such as Profit and Loss, plus objects and fields and custom queries. QuickBooks custom reports and QuickBooks Desktop are not supported, and only one admin can connect QuickBooks at a time. The[Xero connector](https://help.coefficient.io/hc/en-us/articles/51477272618395-Xero) imports reports with comparison periods plus raw invoices, bank transactions, and contacts. Coefficient’s[finance integrations page](https://coefficient.io/integrations/category/finance-accounting) lists two-way sync for QuickBooks, so you can push new entries back.


**Fact card**


- Pricing:[Free $0; Starter $49 per month (one user); Pro $99 per user per month (up to 5 users); Enterprise custom](https://coefficient.io/pricing) , with 17% off for annual prepayment. Coefficient’s Premium source list (Snowflake, BigQuery, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, and others) does not include QuickBooks or Xero, so they work on the standard plans. Verified October 10, 2026.
- Free trial: free plan (3 standard sources, manual refresh).
- Deployment: Google Sheets and Excel add-on.
- Query model: scheduled imports; auto-refresh is daily on Starter and hourly on Pro and Enterprise.
- Security: spreadsheet sharing rules apply. Custom SSO is Enterprise only.
- AI: GPT Copilot and AI functions in the sheet.
- Not ideal for: multi-entity consolidation with eliminations, or dashboards for executives who will not open a spreadsheet.


**Tradeoffs.** Coefficient is the fastest fix for “we export QuickBooks reports to Excel every Monday,” but consolidation, version control, and access control stay as manual as the spreadsheet.


### Zoho Analytics


**Best for:** small companies that want a full BI tool with prebuilt QuickBooks or Xero dashboards for under $50 a month.


Zoho Analytics has dedicated connectors for both ledgers. The[QuickBooks Online connector](https://www.zoho.com/analytics/help/connectors/quickbooks-online.html) creates “50+ default reports & dashboards” on setup, and the[Xero connector](https://www.zoho.com/analytics/help/connectors/xero.html) creates 45+. Both import data on a schedule rather than querying it live, and both are read-only.


**Fact card**


- Pricing:[Basic $24, Standard $48, Premium $115, Enterprise $455 per month billed annually](https://www.zoho.com/analytics/pricing.html) ($30, $60, $145, $575 billed monthly), for 2, 5, 15, and 50 users. Extra users are $6.40 per month billed annually. The Xero connector page says “Xero Analytics is bundled free for all the paid users of Zoho Analytics.” Verified October 10, 2026.
- Free trial: free plan (2 users, 10,000 rows); 15-day trial.
- Deployment: Zoho cloud, or an on-premises edition.
- Query model: QuickBooks syncs daily on Basic, every 3, 6, or 12 hours on Standard and up, and hourly on Enterprise only. “Sync Now” can run up to five times a day.
- Security: row filters through[variables in filter criteria](https://www.zoho.com/analytics/help/workspace/settings/variables.html) ;[SAML SSO through Zoho Directory](https://www.zoho.com/analytics/help/zoho-directory.html) . SCIM is not documented for Zoho Analytics.
- AI: anomaly detection and an MCP server on every plan; conversational analytics on Standard and up; the Ask Zia agent on Premium and up.
- Embedding: private links and an embed API on Premium and Enterprise.
- Not ideal for: multi-entity consolidation with eliminations, or intraday refresh below Enterprise.


**Tradeoffs.** Zoho Analytics is the cheapest full BI tool here and the prebuilt reports save setup time, but row and user caps rise with the plan and hourly sync needs Enterprise. Our[Zoho Analytics alternatives comparison](https://www.basedash.com/blog/zoho-analytics-alternatives-2026-bi-tools-compared) covers when teams outgrow it.


### Databox


**Best for:** owners and operators who want accounting KPIs on the same dashboard as marketing and sales metrics.


Databox has prebuilt metrics for both ledgers. Its[QuickBooks metrics](https://databox.com/metric-library/data-source/quickbooks) include open and overdue invoices and unpaid bills, and the[metric builder](https://help.databox.com/integrate-quickbooks-with-databox) works with Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss reports. The[Xero metrics](https://databox.com/metric-library/data-source/xero) cover executive summary and P&L figures at monthly, quarterly, and yearly granularity, with no metric builder.


**Fact card**


- Pricing:[Free $0; Analyst $71 per month (1 user, 5 sources); Team Core $199 (3 users, 10 sources); Team Scale $319 (10 users, 30 sources), billed annually](https://databox.com/pricing) . Monthly billing is $89, $249, and $399. Verified October 10, 2026.
- Free trial: free plan (1 user, 3 sources, daily sync).
- Deployment: cloud.
- Query model: scheduled sync. QuickBooks has a 24-hour minimum sync frequency and needs admin permission; Xero’s minimum is 1 hour.
- Security: access per data source and per dashboard;[SAML SSO](https://help.databox.com/set-up-single-sign-on-sso) through a $40 per month add-on. SCIM is not supported.
- AI: Genie AI analyst, AI performance summaries, and anomaly detection, metered by AI credits.
- Not ideal for: financial statements, consolidation, or same-day QuickBooks numbers.


**Tradeoffs.** Databox is quick to set up and good for KPI scorecards, but QuickBooks data updates only once a day and the Free and Analyst plans cannot share dashboards. See[Databox alternatives](https://www.basedash.com/vs/databox-alternatives) for comparable tools.


### Basedash


**Best for:** companies that want QuickBooks or Xero data joined with Stripe, HubSpot, Salesforce, or their product database, and want to ask questions in plain English instead of building reports.


Basedash offers[QuickBooks](https://www.basedash.com/data-sources/quickbooks) and[Xero](https://www.basedash.com/data-sources/xero) connectors that sync into Basedash Warehouse, a managed warehouse Basedash provisions for your workspace. The connectors are powered by Fivetran and managed by Basedash, so you do not need a Fivetran account. Fivetran’s QuickBooks connector syncs objects such as invoices, bills, payments, and journal entries rather than QuickBooks’ formatted reports, so a P&L in Basedash is built from those tables by the[AI data analyst](https://www.basedash.com/features/ai-data-analyst) or in SQL.


**Fact card**


- Pricing:[Startup plan at $1,000 per month plus AI usage](https://www.basedash.com/pricing) , for up to 25 users, with $1,000 per month of AI credits included; Enterprise is custom. Connectors and the warehouse are included. Monthly and annual billing. Verified October 10, 2026.
- Free trial: 14 days, no credit card.
- Deployment: cloud;[self-hosting](https://www.basedash.com/docs/self-hosting/overview) on Enterprise (self-hosted deployments connect databases directly, not through connectors).
- Data sources: QuickBooks and Xero plus other[Fivetran-powered sources](https://www.basedash.com/features/data-ingestion) such as Stripe, HubSpot, and Salesforce, and direct connections to PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, and other databases.
- Query model: connector syncs every 15 or 30 minutes, every 1 to 12 hours, or daily, with incremental updates and on-demand syncs; live queries on directly connected databases.
- Consolidation: no built-in consolidation or intercompany eliminations. You can sync several companies and combine them in SQL, but currency translation and eliminations are your logic, not a feature.
- Security: per-source group access and the option to hide schemas, tables, or columns from AI.[Row-level security](https://www.basedash.com/docs/features/row-level-security) applies to Postgres databases only, so it does not filter synced QuickBooks or Xero data.[SAML or OIDC SSO](https://www.basedash.com/docs/features/sso) and SCIM are Enterprise features.
- AI: the AI data analyst writes SQL and builds charts and dashboards from questions;[Insights](https://www.basedash.com/docs/features/insights) posts AI-written explanations of what changed;[automations](https://www.basedash.com/docs/features/automations) send scheduled summaries by email or Slack; an MCP server and Slack app are on every plan.
- Embedding: Enterprise.
- Not ideal for: formatted financial statements, board packs, consolidations with eliminations, or a small company with one QuickBooks file and no other data.


**Tradeoffs.** Basedash is built for questions that cross systems (“revenue by customer from Stripe against invoices in QuickBooks”), not for producing statements. Its $1,000 starting price covers up to 25 users, which is more than Syft, Fathom, or Zoho Analytics cost for a single company.


## What about Power BI, Tableau, and Data Studio?


The big BI tools have stepped back from QuickBooks and Xero:


- **Power BI** lists[“Quickbooks Online (Beta)” with an end-of-support date of August 2025](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-query/connectors/connector-end-of-support) , among connectors that “no longer appear in Power Query.” Microsoft[deprecated its Xero content pack in 2019](https://powerbi.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/explore-and-analyze-your-xero-data-with-power-bi/) .
- **Tableau** says[“as of version 2025.3, the Intuit QuickBooks connector has been retired and is no longer available”](https://help.tableau.com/current/pro/desktop/en-us/examples_quickbooksonline.htm) . Its help has no Xero connector page.
- **Data Studio (formerly Looker Studio)** reaches QuickBooks and Xero only through[partner connectors](https://lookerstudio.google.com/data) , which are built and supported by third parties.


If you want one of these tools, load QuickBooks or Xero into a warehouse first.[Fivetran’s QuickBooks connector](https://fivetran.com/docs/connectors/applications/quickbooks) syncs object tables and provides a P&L view through its[QuickBooks data model](https://fivetran.com/docs/transformations/data-models/quickbooks-data-model) ; the[Xero connector](https://fivetran.com/docs/connectors/applications/xero) supports only Australian payroll endpoints. Fivetran syncs every six hours by default, and its[pricing page](https://www.fivetran.com/pricing) lists 15-minute syncs on Standard. Then connect Power BI, Tableau, or another warehouse-native BI tool to BigQuery, Snowflake, or Postgres. That path adds a warehouse and a pipeline to maintain, which is why most QuickBooks and Xero companies pick a tool from the list above instead.


## Which QuickBooks or Xero reporting tool should you choose?


**If you are a 20-person company using Excel and QuickBooks:** upgrade to QuickBooks Online Advanced if you need custom reports and dashboards for one company, or add Coefficient (free or $49 per month) if the team wants to keep working in Excel with refreshed numbers. Move to Syft or Fathom when you need management reports, forecasts, or a second entity.


**If you run several entities or locations:** Fathom, Syft, Reach, and LiveFlow all document consolidation with eliminations and currency conversion. Syft and Fathom have the lowest published prices, Reach includes unlimited users and a client portal, and LiveFlow keeps the consolidation in a spreadsheet. QuickBooks’ own answer is Intuit Enterprise Suite, which is priced by contract.


**If you are an accounting firm or fractional CFO with many clients:** Fathom’s per-company price falls to $13 per extra company on its 50-company tier, Reach includes unlimited users and portals, and Syft offers unlimited external users. Fathom Portfolio covers lighter oversight across 100 or more clients.

## Frequently asked questions


### Does Power BI still connect to QuickBooks Online?


Not natively. Microsoft’s connector end-of-support list shows the QuickBooks Online (Beta) connector ended support in August 2025 and no longer appears in Power Query. As of October 2026, the options are a third-party connector, or syncing QuickBooks into a warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Postgres with an ELT tool like Fivetran and pointing Power BI at the warehouse. The warehouse route also lets you join QuickBooks with CRM and billing data, but you take on a pipeline and a data model to maintain.


### How do I connect Xero to Tableau or BigQuery?


Tableau’s help has no Xero connector page, and Tableau retired its QuickBooks Online connector in version 2025.3, so the reliable route is a warehouse. Use an ELT connector such as Fivetran’s Xero connector to load Xero into BigQuery, Snowflake, or Postgres, then connect Tableau to that warehouse. Fivetran’s Xero connector re-imports some reference tables on every sync, supports only Australian payroll endpoints, and needs a full re-sync when account codes change. Tools like Zoho Analytics, Databox, Syft, and Basedash connect to Xero without a warehouse you manage.


### What is the best BI tool for a 20-person company using Excel and QuickBooks?


For most 20-person companies, the answer is to improve what you have before adding a BI platform. QuickBooks Online Advanced ($340 per month at list, up to 25 users) adds custom reports, KPI dashboards, and Excel sync. Coefficient refreshes QuickBooks reports in Excel or Google Sheets from free to $99 per user per month. If you also need CRM or ecommerce data on the same dashboards, Zoho Analytics starts at $24 per month billed annually with 50+ prebuilt QuickBooks reports. Basedash fits when the questions span QuickBooks, Stripe, and a product database, at $1,000 per month.


### Which AI tools can answer questions about QuickBooks or Xero data in plain English?


Inside the accounting apps, QuickBooks offers Finance AI on Advanced plus AI chat in beta on lower plans, and Xero offers its JAX assistant. Among reporting apps, Fathom, Syft, and Reach generate written commentary and flag anomalies, but natural language questions are not documented for them. Basedash’s AI data analyst answers questions over synced QuickBooks and Xero data and returns the SQL behind each chart. Zoho Analytics has conversational analytics on Standard plans and up, and Databox’s Genie answers questions over its synced metrics.


### Which QuickBooks and Xero reporting tools handle multi-entity consolidation?


Four tools in this comparison document consolidation with eliminations. Fathom handles up to 300 entities across systems and currencies. Syft consolidates unlimited entities with account-level or transaction-level eliminations and FX. Reach Reporting consolidates multiple entities and currencies using historical exchange rates. LiveFlow consolidates in 160+ currencies with intercompany eliminations and ownership percentages inside Google Sheets or Excel. QuickBooks Online Advanced has no consolidated view; Intuit lists combined multi-company dashboards under Intuit Enterprise Suite. BI tools such as Zoho Analytics and Basedash can combine entities only through your own modeling.


### How often do QuickBooks and Xero dashboards refresh in these tools?


Native QuickBooks and Xero reports run on current data, though QuickBooks dashboard visuals update every 2 hours. Fathom and Syft refresh every 24 hours and allow a manual sync. Coefficient refreshes daily on Starter and hourly on Pro, and LiveFlow can refresh every hour. Zoho Analytics syncs QuickBooks daily on Basic, every 3 hours on Standard and up, and hourly only on Enterprise. Databox syncs QuickBooks once a day and Xero hourly. Basedash connector syncs run as often as every 15 minutes. For most month-end reporting, daily is enough; hourly or better matters for cash and collections dashboards.


### Do I need QuickBooks Online Advanced to build custom dashboards?


Custom Report Builder, customizable KPI dashboards, Spreadsheet Sync, and Finance AI are listed on Advanced, which costs $340 per month at list price. Essentials and Plus include third-party data in KPIs and dashboards but not the full custom builder. If you would rather not upgrade every QuickBooks seat, an outside tool can read data from lower plans: Syft has a free plan, Fathom starts at $59 per company per month, Coefficient connects on its free plan, and Zoho Analytics or Databox build dashboards from the QuickBooks connector.
